entries.reason: Desktop language dropdown rows are popover list rows, not buttons: the hover is a solid --accent-hover fill (dE >> 10) under the same trigger that has the disc; a disc inside a 2-row popover would only slow selection. Burger EN/DE (375) are real outline buttons and DO use the disc.
Option is already highlighted (keyboard/open highlight .is-focus) before the pointer arrives, so rest == hover by design; popover row, see the entry above.

Button on a PHOTO (sky): white-on-blue disc would be 2.9-4.2:1 on the photo; hover = 1px underline + arrow moves 4px (customer rule H3, pages/services.css). Owner decision documented in design-system.md.
